name: Density Grid Sampler (JNeRF)
definition: A sampler that uses a 3D density grid (occupancy grid) to accelerate ray marching in NeRF by skipping empty space, using cascaded grids and non-uniform sampling.
summary: The Density Grid Sampler is a NeRF ray-marching acceleration technique that uses cascaded 3D occupancy grids to skip empty space and combines uniform background with non-uniform foreground samples to balance rendering quality and computational cost.
